newsitem.title: USA: NGPL says leak on U.S. Gulf natgas line.
newsitem.headline: NGPL says leak on U.S. Gulf natgas line.

text.p: Natural Gas Pipeline (NGPL) said Thursday a leak on a natural gas pipeline feeding into a gas gathering system off Louisiana has cut about 16 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) of natural gas output.
The leak was near Vermilion Block 340, an NGPL spokeswoman said. It was not immediately clear which line was leaking nor the volumes affected.
"There are four blocks involved in the shut in. They're not sure which block is leaking, so on Saturday, they'll turn them on one at a time," the company spokeswoman said.
Production from Vermilion Blocks 318, 328, 329 and 348 have been shut in pending investigation and/or repairs, she said.
NGPL operates the laterals connecting Vermilion Blocks 348 and 340 to the Stingray tap at Vermilion 321.
